CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_feedback_open_count()
 RETURNS TABLE(open_count integer, active_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'OPEN')::integer AS open_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'DECLINED'))::integer AS active_count
  FROM public.feedback_items;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_learning_leaderboard(p_limit integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, name text, designation text, employee_id text, is_admin boolean, mastered_count integer, streak_days integer, accuracy_pct smallint, total_answered integer, xp integer, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 25), 1), 100);
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id AS user_id,
    p.name,
    p.designation,
    p.employee_id,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = p.id) AS is_admin,
    ulp.mastered_count,
    ulp.streak_days,
    ulp.accuracy_pct,
    ulp.total_answered,
    ulp.xp,
    ulp.updated_at
  FROM public.user_learning_progress ulp
  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ulp.user_id
  WHERE ulp.leaderboard_opt_in = true
  ORDER BY
    ulp.mastered_count DESC,
    ulp.xp DESC,
    ulp.accuracy_pct DESC,
    ulp.streak_days DESC,
    LOWER(p.name) ASC
  LIMIT v_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_members_directory()

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    p.designation,
    p.employee_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_profiles_by_ids(user_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, employee_id text, is_admin boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  IF user_ids IS NULL OR array_length(user_ids, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    p.employee_id,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = p.id) AS is_admin
  FROM public.profiles p
  WHERE p.id = ANY(user_ids);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_public_profile(target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, designation text, employee_id text, mobile text, show_mobile boolean, avatar_url text, is_admin boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, approved_requests_count bigint, votes_cast_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    p.designation,
    p.employee_id,
    CASE
      WHEN p.show_mobile = true OR p.id = auth.uid() THEN p.mobile
      ELSE NULL
    END AS mobile,
    p.show_mobile,
    p.avatar_url,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = p.id) AS is_admin,
    p.created_at,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
      FROM public.edit_requests er
      WHERE er.requested_by = p.id
        AND er.status = 'APPROVED'
    ) AS approved_requests_count,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
      FROM public.request_approvals ra
      WHERE ra.approved_by = p.id
    ) AS votes_cast_count
  FROM public.profiles p
  WHERE p.id = target_user_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_post_office_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (TG_OP = 'INSERT') THEN
        IF NEW.last_approved_by IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, new_data, changed_by, approved_by)
            VALUES (
                NEW.id,
                'INSERT',
                row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb,
                COALESCE(NEW.last_modified_by, NEW.user_id, auth.uid()),
                NEW.last_approved_by
            );
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;

    ELSIF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE') THEN
        -- Ignore case-only capitalization updates; log only real content/PIN/delete changes
        IF (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW."Address", ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD."Address", '')))
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW."Office", ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD."Office", '')))
            OR NEW."Pin" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Pin"
            OR NEW.is_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_deleted
        ) AND NEW.last_approved_by IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, old_data, new_data, changed_by, approved_by)
            VALUES (
                NEW.id,
                'UPDATE',
                row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb,
                row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb,
                COALESCE(NEW.last_modified_by, auth.uid()),
                NEW.last_approved_by
            );
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;

    ELSIF (TG_OP = 'DELETE') THEN
        INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, old_data, changed_by, approved_by)
        VALUES (
            OLD.id,
            'DELETE',
            row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb,
            COALESCE(OLD.last_modified_by, auth.uid()),
            OLD.last_approved_by
        );
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;

    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_edit_requests(p_tab text DEFAULT 'pending'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_action_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_user_role text DEFAULT 'requested'::text, p_date_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_date_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_office text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_pin text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_pending_scope text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_vote_progress text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_resolved_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_approval_source text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_only_mine boolean DEFAULT false, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, post_office_id bigint, action_type text, proposed_data jsonb, original_data jsonb, requested_by uuid, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, last_approved_by uuid, po_address text, po_office text, po_pin integer, requester_name text, requester_emp_id text, requester_is_admin boolean, finalizer_id uuid, finalizer_name text, finalizer_emp_id text, finalizer_is_admin boolean, vote_count integer, has_user_voted boolean, approved_by_admin boolean, is_admin_direct boolean, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid           UUID := auth.uid();
  v_tab           TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_tab, 'pending'));
  v_search        TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_search, '')), '');
  v_search_like   TEXT := NULL;
  v_phon          TEXT := '';
  v_phon_enabled  BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_phon_like     TEXT := NULL;
  v_office_raw    TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_office, '')), '');
  v_office_like   TEXT := NULL;
  v_pin_raw       TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_pin, '')), '');
  v_pin_like      TEXT := NULL;
  v_user_role     TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_user_role, 'requested'));
  v_pending_scope TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_pending_scope, 'all'));
  v_vote_progress TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_vote_progress, 'all'));
  v_res_status    TEXT := UPPER(COALESCE(p_resolved_status, 'all'));
  v_appr_source   TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_approval_source, 'all'));
  v_sort          TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_sort, 'newest'));
  v_limit         INTEGER := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 50));
  v_offset        INTEGER := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_offset, 0));
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Escape LIKE wildcards (\, %, _) safely
  IF v_search IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_search_like := '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_search, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
    IF v_search ~ '[A-Za-z]' THEN
      v_phon := public.postal_phonetic_key(v_search);
      IF length(v_phon) >= 2 THEN
        v_phon_enabled := TRUE;
        IF length(v_phon) >= 3 THEN
          v_phon_like := '%' || v_phon || '%';
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_office_raw IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_office_like := '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_office_raw, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
  END IF;

  IF v_pin_raw IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_pin_like := '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_pin_raw, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      er.id,
      er.post_office_id,
      er.action_type,
      er.proposed_data,
      er.original_data,
      er.requested_by,
      er.status,
      er.created_at,
      er.last_approved_by,
      po."Address" AS po_address,
      po."Office"  AS po_office,
      po."Pin"     AS po_pin,
      COALESCE(req_p.name, 'Unknown User')       AS requester_name,
      COALESCE(req_p.employee_id, 'No ID')       AS requester_emp_id,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = er.requested_by) AS requester_is_admin,
      CASE
        WHEN er.status = 'APPROVED' THEN COALESCE(v.last_voter_id, er.last_approved_by)
        WHEN er.status = 'REJECTED' THEN er.last_approved_by
        ELSE NULL
      END AS finalizer_id,
      COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0)                  AS vote_count,
      COALESCE(v.has_user_voted, FALSE)          AS has_user_voted,
      (
        er.status = 'APPROVED'
        AND COALESCE(
          v.last_voter_is_admin,
          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = er.last_approved_by)
        )
      ) AS approved_by_admin
    FROM public.edit_requests er
    LEFT JOIN public.post_offices po
      ON po.id = er.post_office_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles req_p
      ON req_p.id = er.requested_by
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS vote_count,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(ra.approved_by = v_uid), FALSE) AS has_user_voted,
        (
          SELECT ra2.approved_by
          FROM public.request_approvals ra2
          WHERE ra2.request_id = er.id
          ORDER BY ra2.approved_at DESC, ra2.id DESC
          LIMIT 1
        ) AS last_voter_id,
        (
          SELECT COALESCE(ra2.is_admin, FALSE)
          FROM public.request_approvals ra2
          WHERE ra2.request_id = er.id
          ORDER BY ra2.approved_at DESC, ra2.id DESC
          LIMIT 1
        ) AS last_voter_is_admin
      FROM public.request_approvals ra
      WHERE ra.request_id = er.id
    ) v ON TRUE
    WHERE
      (
        (v_tab = 'pending'  AND er.status = 'PENDING')
        OR (v_tab <> 'pending' AND er.status <> 'PENDING')
      )
      AND (
        p_action_types IS NULL
        OR array_length(p_action_types, 1) IS NULL
        OR er.action_type = ANY(p_action_types)
      )
      AND (p_date_from IS NULL OR er.created_at >= p_date_from)
      AND (p_date_to   IS NULL OR er.created_at <  p_date_to)
      AND (NOT COALESCE(p_only_mine, FALSE) OR er.requested_by = v_uid)
      AND (
        v_office_like IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(er.proposed_data->>'Office', er.proposed_data->>'office', '') ILIKE v_office_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(er.original_data->>'Office', er.original_data->>'office', '') ILIKE v_office_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(po."Office", '') ILIKE v_office_like ESCAPE '\'
      )
      AND (
        v_pin_like IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(er.proposed_data->>'Pin', er.proposed_data->>'pin', '') ILIKE v_pin_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(er.original_data->>'Pin', er.original_data->>'pin', '') ILIKE v_pin_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(po."Pin"::text, '') ILIKE v_pin_like ESCAPE '\'
      )
  ),
  enriched AS (
    SELECT
      b.*,
      fin_p.name        AS finalizer_name,
      fin_p.employee_id AS finalizer_emp_id,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = b.finalizer_id) AS finalizer_is_admin,
      (
        b.status = 'APPROVED'
        AND b.approved_by_admin
        AND b.requested_by = b.finalizer_id
      ) AS is_admin_direct
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles fin_p
      ON fin_p.id = b.finalizer_id
  ),
  filtered AS (
    SELECT e.*
    FROM enriched e
    WHERE
      -- Specific User + Role Scope
      (
        p_user_id IS NULL
        OR (v_user_role = 'requested' AND e.requested_by = p_user_id)
        OR (v_user_role = 'reviewed'  AND e.status <> 'PENDING' AND e.finalizer_id = p_user_id)
        OR (v_user_role = 'voted'     AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.request_approvals ra3
              WHERE ra3.request_id = e.id AND ra3.approved_by = p_user_id
            ))
        OR (v_user_role = 'any' AND (
              e.requested_by = p_user_id
              OR e.finalizer_id = p_user_id
              OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM public.request_approvals ra4
                WHERE ra4.request_id = e.id AND ra4.approved_by = p_user_id
              )
            ))
      )
      -- Pending-specific filters
      AND (
        v_tab <> 'pending'
        OR (
          (
            v_pending_scope = 'all'
            OR (v_pending_scope = 'needs_my_vote' AND e.requested_by <> v_uid AND NOT e.has_user_voted)
            OR (v_pending_scope = 'i_voted'       AND e.has_user_voted)
            OR (v_pending_scope = 'my_requests'   AND e.requested_by = v_uid)
          )
          AND (
            v_vote_progress = 'all'
            OR (v_vote_progress = 'zero'          AND e.vote_count = 0)
            OR (v_vote_progress = 'near_approval' AND e.vote_count >= 3)
          )
        )
      )
      -- Resolved-specific filters
      AND (
        v_tab = 'pending'
        OR (
          (
            v_res_status = 'ALL'
            OR e.status = v_res_status
          )
          AND (
            v_appr_source = 'all'
            OR (v_appr_source = 'admin_direct'   AND e.is_admin_direct)
            OR (v_appr_source = 'admin_approved' AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND e.approved_by_admin AND NOT e.is_admin_direct)
            OR (v_appr_source = 'community'      AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT e.approved_by_admin)
          )
        )
      )
      -- Universal Search (ILIKE across Address, Office, PIN, Users + Phonetic Address/Office)
      AND (
        v_search_like IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Address', e.proposed_data->>'address', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Address', e.original_data->>'address', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.po_address, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Office', e.proposed_data->>'office', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Office', e.original_data->>'office', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.po_office, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Pin', e.proposed_data->>'pin', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Pin', e.original_data->>'pin', '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.po_pin::text, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.requester_name, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.requester_emp_id, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.finalizer_name, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(e.finalizer_emp_id, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR (
          v_phon_enabled AND (
            public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Address', e.proposed_data->>'address', '')) = v_phon
            OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Address', e.original_data->>'address', '')) = v_phon
            OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.po_address, '')) = v_phon
            OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Office', e.proposed_data->>'office', '')) = v_phon
            OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Office', e.original_data->>'office', '')) = v_phon
            OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.po_office, '')) = v_phon
            OR (
              v_phon_like IS NOT NULL AND (
                public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Address', e.proposed_data->>'address', '')) LIKE v_phon_like
                OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Address', e.original_data->>'address', '')) LIKE v_phon_like
                OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.po_address, '')) LIKE v_phon_like
                OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.proposed_data->>'Office', e.proposed_data->>'office', '')) LIKE v_phon_like
                OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.original_data->>'Office', e.original_data->>'office', '')) LIKE v_phon_like
                OR public.postal_phonetic_key(COALESCE(e.po_office, '')) LIKE v_phon_like
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    f.id,
    f.post_office_id,
    f.action_type,
    f.proposed_data,
    f.original_data,
    f.requested_by,
    f.status,
    f.created_at,
    f.last_approved_by,
    f.po_address,
    f.po_office,
    f.po_pin,
    f.requester_name,
    f.requester_emp_id,
    f.requester_is_admin,
    f.finalizer_id,
    f.finalizer_name,
    f.finalizer_emp_id,
    f.finalizer_is_admin,
    f.vote_count,
    f.has_user_voted,
    f.approved_by_admin,
    f.is_admin_direct,
    COUNT(*) OVER()::bigint AS total_count
  FROM filtered f
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN v_sort = 'most_votes' THEN f.vote_count END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN v_sort IN ('oldest', 'most_votes') THEN f.created_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN v_sort NOT IN ('oldest', 'most_votes') THEN f.created_at END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN v_sort IN ('oldest', 'most_votes') THEN f.id END ASC NULLS LAST,
    f.id DESC
  LIMIT v_limit
  OFFSET v_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_feedback_items(p_type text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_only_mine boolean DEFAULT false, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, type text, category text, severity text, title text, description text, status text, attachment_path text, device_meta jsonb, admin_response text, resolved_in_version text, reviewed_by uuid, reviewed_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, reporter_name text, reporter_emp_id text, reporter_is_admin boolean, reviewer_name text, reviewer_emp_id text, vote_count integer, has_user_voted boolean, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid         uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_admin    boolean := false;
  v_type        text := UPPER(COALESCE(p_type, 'ALL'));
  v_status      text := UPPER(COALESCE(p_status, 'ALL'));
  v_category    text := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_category, '')), '');
  v_search      text := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_search, '')), '');
  v_search_like text := NULL;
  v_sort        text := LOWER(COALESCE(p_sort, 'newest'));
  v_limit       integer := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 8), 50));
  v_offset      integer := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_offset, 0));
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = v_uid) INTO v_is_admin;

  IF v_search IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_search_like := '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_search, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      fi.id,
      fi.user_id,
      fi.type,
      fi.category,
      fi.severity,
      fi.title,
      fi.description,
      fi.status,
      fi.attachment_path,
      CASE
        WHEN v_is_admin OR fi.user_id = v_uid THEN fi.device_meta
        ELSE NULL
      END AS device_meta,
      fi.admin_response,
      fi.resolved_in_version,
      fi.reviewed_by,
      fi.reviewed_at,
      fi.created_at,
      fi.updated_at,
      COALESCE(rep_p.name, 'Unknown User') AS reporter_name,
      COALESCE(rep_p.employee_id, 'No ID') AS reporter_emp_id,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admins a WHERE a.id = fi.user_id) AS reporter_is_admin,
      rev_p.name AS reviewer_name,
      rev_p.employee_id AS reviewer_emp_id,
      COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0) AS vote_count,
      COALESCE(v.has_user_voted, false) AS has_user_voted
    FROM public.feedback_items fi
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles rep_p ON rep_p.id = fi.user_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles rev_p ON rev_p.id = fi.reviewed_by
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS vote_count,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(fv.user_id = v_uid), false) AS has_user_voted
      FROM public.feedback_votes fv
      WHERE fv.feedback_id = fi.id
    ) v ON true
    WHERE
      (v_type = 'ALL' OR fi.type = v_type)
      AND (
        v_status = 'ALL'
        OR (v_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fi.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'DECLINED'))
        OR (v_status = 'DONE' AND fi.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'DECLINED'))
        OR fi.status = v_status
      )
      AND (v_category IS NULL OR LOWER(fi.category) = LOWER(v_category))
      AND (NOT COALESCE(p_only_mine, false) OR fi.user_id = v_uid)
      AND (
        v_search_like IS NULL
        OR fi.title ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR fi.description ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR fi.category ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(fi.admin_response, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(rep_p.name, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
        OR COALESCE(rep_p.employee_id, '') ILIKE v_search_like ESCAPE '\'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    b.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER()::bigint AS total_count
  FROM base b
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN v_sort = 'most_voted' THEN b.vote_count END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN b.created_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN v_sort <> 'oldest' THEN b.created_at END DESC NULLS LAST,
    b.id DESC
  LIMIT v_limit
  OFFSET v_offset;
END;
$function$
